| INLINE STATS group_total = SUM(assets) BY server.registered_domain
| EVAL rank_key = CONCAT(TO_STRING(1000000000 + group_total), server.registered_domain)
| INLINE STATS rank_keys = TOP(rank_key, 100, "desc")
| WHERE MV_CONTAINS(MV_SLICE(MV_SORT(MV_DEDUPE(rank_keys), "DESC"), 0, 9), rank_key)
| SORT group_total DESC, server.registered_domain ASC
| KEEP server.registered_domain, projectdiscovery.asset.source_type, assets
